recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes ConceptMap unmapped behavior again.
issue_request: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue asking how ConceptMap.group.unmapped.url can be a canonical URL for another map and whether it applies when a source concept has an explicit unmatched mapping; the approved resolution said it references another ConceptMap used when no mapping entry exists, clarified that unmapped excludes explicitly unmatched mappings, and requested explanatory unmapped documentation.
initial_application: The issue was applied by d75acd989aa64eb9de7ae6a439abe0b3377ecfdd, the git-svn revision 14637 commit titled 'GF#14687 - clarifications for ConceptMap.group.unmapped'. That commit added the Handling Unmapped Codes narrative and updated the then-active ConceptMap spreadsheet definitions for group.unmapped and group.unmapped.url.
additional_context: ConceptMap is an active current resource in source/fhir.ini and belongs to the Vocabulary work group. Later R5/R6 changes renamed ConceptMap.group.unmapped.url to ConceptMap.group.unmapped.otherMap and changed the old unmatched-equivalence language to current relationship/noMap semantics. FHIR-32545 directly explains the url-to-otherMap rename, and FHIR-22100 is a later same-family unmapped-mode clarification already represented on the combined branch. The Jira-linked April 2018 Zulip thread supports the other-map fallback use case; Confluence had no direct FHIR-14687 references.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope ConceptMap source already contains the requested explanation: conceptmap-notes.xml has a Handling Unmapped Codes section, describes other-map as using the canonical URL in otherMap, and says unmapped is not used when a matching code has relationship not-related-to. structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml defines group.unmapped as default behavior when no mapping target exists and defines group.unmapped.otherMap as a canonical reference to another ConceptMap.

related_jiras.note: Renamed ConceptMap.group.unmapped.url to ConceptMap.group.unmapped.otherMap, explaining the current element name used for the FHIR-14687 behavior.
Clarified ConceptMap unmapped-mode descriptions and is already represented on the combined branch, supporting the current no-change interpretation.
